PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gentle postpartum recovery and gradual strength rebuild"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Early Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x20s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x20s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 2x30s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x20s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x20s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          neck_roll 2x8 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Gentle Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x25s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x25s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Mobility & Walking":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 2x35s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x25s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x25s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          neck_roll 2x10 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2: Gentle Strength & Mobility" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 2x40s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x30s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          neck_roll 2x12 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x35s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x35s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Mobility & Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 2x45s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x35s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x35s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          neck_roll 2x14 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3: Foundation Strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Foundation Strength & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 40 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          step_up 2x8 rpe 4 rest 40 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x40s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Foundation Strength & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m

          neck_roll 2x16 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 6:

          walking 8m

          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 40 seconds
          bird_dog 3x14 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          step_up 2x10 rpe 4 rest 40 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x45s rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Foundation Strength & Mobility":
        warmup:

    WEEK 7:

  PHASE "Phase 4: Progressive Strength & Endurance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive Strength & Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x18 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
